ambiguities.description: ProjectName uniqueness: The transcript states 'each project also has exactly one project name,' establishing that each Project has one ProjectName. However, it is unclear whether ProjectName values are globally unique across all projects (i.e., can two different projects have the same name). If project names must be unique, a value_constraint uniqueness should be added; if not, the model stands as-is.

source_references.excerpt: Each project also has exactly one project name.

ambiguities.description: Mentoring relationship directionality: While the constraints clearly express irreflexivity and acyclicity, the role interpretation needs clarification. In the fact type 'Employee mentors Employee,' the first role is the mentor (active) and the second is the mentee (passive). The constraint 'each employee has at most one mentor' applies to the mentee position. A mentor can have many mentees (confirmed at line 19). The model assumes this asymmetry; confirm the reading '{0} mentors {1}' aligns with the intended meaning.

source_references.excerpt: Each employee has at most one mentor, who is also an employee. Yes, a mentor can have many mentees. It is the mentee side that is limited to one mentor.
